integrity: The explicit inverse potential and standard one-dimensional first-passage Green formula are credited as foundations. The claim is the evaluated variance phase boundary, exact plateau and centered limit; infinite limits are proved analytically, not certified by numerical checks.
scientific_limitations: Fixed \(A>0\) and \(0<\alpha<2\), unit generator diffusion coefficient, exact prescribed mean and absorbing origin; initial distance tends to infinity.
The quadratic endpoint \(\alpha=2\), noisy-data inference, robustness for approximate means, and finite-distance remainder bounds at/above criticality are not claimed.
The spatial-increment martingale is a distributionally consistent coupling; it is not a common-noise construction across starts.
title: A two-thirds absolute-fluctuation transition in inverse first-passage landscapes
